#### What's great [...] c15t 2.0
Will De Ath

#### What's great

Notra is connected to our entire content pipeline and I now use it daily at Inth. It creates valuable content from our PRs that our audience actually want to read. It makes the gap smaller between what our devs are shipping for c15t + our other products and our audience knowing about why its important to them. There's now no more relevant features that are shipped and not talk about. Notra closes that loop for us.

#### What needs improvement

Would love to see how other forms on comms like email newsletter sections could help me draft product update in platforms like Resend. [...] This one's not an improvement, more that I'm completely excited by the image generation, especially copying Figma, that Dom has recently shared, it needs to come out now. The quality and accuracy of these images to brand guidelines and what's actually in the code base in unreal.

#### vs Alternatives

Nothing plugs into our PRs like Notra does. Sure you can ask any content gen AI tool to help you write a X post about a recent PR by sending it a link, but Notra actually does this in context and doesn't miss a beat.
